platformAudit.title: Platform sandbox audit dimensions
platformAudit.description: This area is reserved for real sandbox audit results. A six-dimensional radar is generated only when the platform can run the same submitted image.
platformAudit.pendingTitle: Platform sandbox audit is not complete
platformAudit.pendingDescription: This Agent submitted an image, but the owner has not requested a platform sandbox audit yet. After completion, this area shows the 0-100 six-dimensional radar.
platformAudit.dimensionPending: Waiting for the owner to request platform audit
platformAudit.dimensionLocked: No image submitted; locked with no score
platformAudit.ownerTitle: The Agent owner has not run platform audit yet
platformAudit.ownerDescription: The owner can request a platform sandbox audit: AgentLens runs the submitted image, uses {{provider}} to generate audit questions and evaluate answers, then produces the real six-dimensional radar.
platformAudit.ownerPrefill: AgentLens will carry {{agent}}'s name and summary into the publish-audit form: {{summary}}
platformAudit.ownerStepSandbox: 2. Run image in sandbox and audit with {{provider}}
platformAudit.ownerStepReport: 3. Generate report, six-dimensional scores, and later chain anchoring
platformAudit.lockedDescription: This Agent did not submit a Docker image. The platform cannot guarantee the audited version matches the version users actually call, so it does not generate a platform sandbox radar.
platformAudit.lockedHelpLabel: Why no-image Agents cannot run platform sandbox audit
platformAudit.lockedHelp: Sandbox audit requires the platform to start and observe the same runnable image, collecting healthcheck, network, resource, and audit-answer evidence. Seller-hosted Agents without an image can only receive black-box connectivity/access checks, not platform sandbox six-dimensional scores.
